tei:div.tei:p: I praise the justice of my Creator on the day appointed for the examination of deeds. His majesty is great, but the way of His humility accords with His greatness. He is Lord of the world, who can resist Him and remain unharmed? He remembers the man who walks in uprightness, and graciously promotes the cause of the orphan. Pure, lofty and exalted, He has made everything harmoniously in its time. Although Almighty, He does not reject the man who in his own eyes is despised and rejected. Glorified, riding above the clouds, radiance is in front of Him and blazing fire. He rages with sharp swords on behalf of orphans and widows. He requites man according to his work. He shapes the mouth and also makes it dumb. Owner of all in compassion, He is lofty and lowers the lofty. He judges His creatures with clemency, perfect in action, God of faithfulness. Earthly judges are as nought, they are frightened through dread of Him and perplexed. He executes the judgment of His people, warning them first of His wrath. Noble ones tremble at the thought of their judgment, as to whether they have accomplished His law. He sees all that are hidden, He dwells in the loftiest heights. He perceives all that is happening, He explores all that is about to come. He summons the generations from the very beginning in order to search out and discover the thoughts of their hearts. O Thou who dost remember the covenant with those who came first, fulfil the promise to those who come last.
